stations.title: Agnieszka
stations.say: Why is Hettie still on lane 1?

stations.title: New session
stations.text: Puts the board back to the morning bookings.

captions: Next, Agnieszka takes Hettie off lane 1, and Hettie stays on the board.
She goes only when a letter is typed, and New session brings back the wrong names.
Take off and Add show at once, the bookings stay as they came, and the rest stays put.
Hettie leaves the board at once, and the morning's bookings still have her.
Same board, same buttons. Every change draws at once and touches one lane.
